reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: updateTeamLeaders has a non-test caller (TeamManagementClient.tsx:121). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json. Gate 3: src/lib/actions/teams.ts is explicitly in scope. Spec deviation is confirmed — the delete-then-insert pattern uses two separate Supabase HTTP calls with no wrapping transaction, making the operation non-atomic as required by the invariant. Attack path is rated potential rather than confirmed because triggering the partial failure requires an INSERT error (e.g., constraint violation) that is not fully attacker-controllable without admin access and a specific error condition.
